name: XQuAD: Cross-Lingual Question Answering Dataset
description: XQuAD (Cross-lingual Question Answering Dataset) is a multilingual question answering benchmark consisting of 240 context paragraphs and 1,190 question-answer pairs from SQuAD v1.1, professionally translated into 10 target languages (Spanish, German, Greek, Russian, Turkish, Arabic, Vietnamese, Thai, Chinese, Hindi) alongside original English. Designed to evaluate zero-shot cross-lingual transfer for extractive reading comprehension, every example is aligned across languages.
